pricing.billing_basis: duration of audio streamed, including silence and retries; rate-dependent estimate, not an invoice

protocol_caveat: The request names only a language; the server reports the model it selected (zoom-asr-en-v1) in session.updated, and a different echo fails the attempt. Zoom segments speech with its own voice activity detection and sends one final transcript per segment, with no partials. input_audio_buffer.commit at speech end is not in the published live-mode reference but is honored: it ends the open segment at the commit point. A commit with no open segment produces no event, so there is no finalize acknowledgment; completion is session.closed after session.close, which flushes every open segment. The documented default limit is 20 concurrent sessions.
